# brig print-fedora-deps

Print the Fedora packages brig needs on this host

## Synopsis

```text
brig print-fedora-deps
```

## Description

Print the Fedora packages brig needs on this host, as one line suitable for
dnf. The required packages are always included; --with adds optional groups.

## Examples

```sh
sudo dnf install $(brig print-fedora-deps)
sudo dnf install $(brig print-fedora-deps --with mounts)
brig print-fedora-deps --with all --explain
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--explain` | print a table with the reason for each package |
| `--with stringSlice` | optional package groups to include: mounts, push, secrets or all |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
